youtube.title: Napoleon got left on read by Josephine 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Napoleon could conquer Italy. He could NOT get Josephine to text back 💀

What's the worst text YOU sent after being left on read? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in 1796, while leading the Army of Italy, Napoleon sent Josephine letter after passionate letter and kept complaining that she hardly wrote back. In one real letter he told her "I don't love you anymore; on the contrary, I detest you"... and in the same letter said he hoped to hold her in his arms soon.
